tools.name: inspect_page
tools.description: Inspect a single web page for HTML/CSS quality, accessibility (WCAG/KWCAG), SEO, and performance/security. Returns scores, grades, and top issues. Takes 10-30 seconds.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the web page to inspect (must start with http:// or https://)

params.name: language
params.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean

params.name: accessibility_standard
params.description: Accessibility standard to check against (default: wcag_2.1_aa)

tools.name: inspect_site
tools.description: Start a site-wide crawl and inspection. Crawls links from the root URL and inspects each page. Returns a site_inspection_id for tracking. Use get_inspection to check results later.

params.name: url
params.description: Root URL of the site to crawl and inspect

params.name: language
params.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean

params.name: max_depth
params.description: Maximum link depth to crawl (default: 2, max: 3)

params.name: max_pages
params.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (default: 20, max: 500, 0: unlimited)

params.name: accessibility_standard
params.description: Accessibility standard to check against (default: wcag_2.1_aa)

tools.name: get_inspection
tools.description: Get detailed inspection results by inspection ID. Works for both single-page and site inspections.

params.name: id
params.description: The inspection_id or site_inspection_id to retrieve

params.name: language
params.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean

tools.name: get_issues
tools.description: Get a filtered list of issues found during an inspection. Works with both single-page inspection_id and site_inspection_id. For site inspections, aggregates issues from all pages.

params.name: id
params.description: The inspection_id or site_inspection_id to get issues for

params.name: language
params.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean

params.name: page_url
params.description: For site inspections: filter issues by page URL substring

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: List recent inspection history. Optionally filter by URL substring.

params.name: url
params.description: Optional URL substring to filter results

params.name: language
params.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean
